title: The unique threshold bound state of the SU(N) BFSS model
summary: For every finite N ≥ 2, we prove that undeformed $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (N)`$ BFSS matrix quantum mechanics has exactly one normalizable zero-energy state after removing the center of mass. This establishes the threshold-bound-state conjecture.
family_title: Threshold and positive-energy bound states of the BFSS matrix model

review.reason: Proves uniqueness of the zero-energy normalizable state in SU(N) BFSS matrix quantum mechanics.
